## What it does

ESDMS is a set of linked R scripts that read the output from the lab's analytical instruments, match it to chain-of-custody records, apply detection-limit flags and QC checks, and build a searchable sample database. Quarto templates turn each batch into a PDF lab report with QA/QC notes.

## Highlights

- Parsers for Omnion, Shimadzu, and Agilent Cary 60 instrument exports and chain-of-custody sheets
- Raw values, MDL flags, and reference constants are handled the same way across the whole pipeline
- Automated per-analyte QC loops and PDF lab reports
- A Windows desktop app lets the team browse the sample archive and search the database without R or Python
